leadText:
Evian (Japanese: コロク Koroku) is a character of the day who appeared in the episode From Cradle to Save. He is a student of Angela's in a Pokémon Ninja School deep in the forest.

After being assigned to keep an eye on and , he later took them to the school, seeing they weren't the thieves that he was looking for. As part of the ninja training, Evian and Ash were assigned to find and capture Angela's , which he almost did. He later helped defeat , as they were the actual thieves who were stealing from them.
